> 第1章 剑帝重生（第1页）
深夜，冷清的房间内一个全身缠满绷带的少年猛然惊醒，然后一脸疑惑的看着周围陌生的环境。
他叫任逍遥，是神武界十大封号武帝中排名第二的剑帝，剑、丹双修，年仅六十便已成为神武界剑道第一人。
前一刻，他不敌万千邪魔，自爆于天魔山脉。
可是一眨眼的功夫，他居然出现在了这个陌生的地方，并且诡异的变成了一个身受重伤的少年。
就在任逍遥猜测自己是不是夺舍了少年时，脑袋一阵剧痛传来，随后任逍遥的脑海中涌入了大量记忆。
这些记忆来自这具身体的主人，等到痛楚消失，任逍遥消化了脑海中的记忆，对周围的一切也有了解了。
他不是夺舍，而是重生了，重生到了一个名为陆宸的少年身上，而且是重生到了百年之后。
至于陆宸，他是天元城四大家族之一陆家的成员，今年十六岁，一个可怜的小家伙。
六年前，陆宸的老爹陆毅在落枫山脉遭遇神秘人偷袭，丹田和经脉尽数被毁，成为了废人。
之后，凭借一己之力带领整个陆家从末流家族一跃成为天元城最强家族，整体实力仅次于城主府的陆毅被剥夺家主之位，由大哥陆乾继任家主之位。
陆宸十二岁检测出金、土双属性上品地脉，成为天元城近三百年来天赋第一人，就连城主府都比不了。
在之后短短的四年时间里，陆宸武道突飞猛进，一举到了七重武师境，更是被外出修行的剑阁九长老黎武看中，允诺其可进入剑阁修行。
一时之间，陆宸成为了天元城最耀眼的少年。
不过，就在所有人都以为陆宸前途无限时，惨案再次发生，陆宸经脉和丹田被废，变成了和陆毅一样的废人。
和陆毅不同，被废的陆宸白天接到邀请，去了一趟天香阁，不久后便爆出猥亵林家天之骄女林轩。
替天行道，原本经脉和丹田被毁的陆宸被打断四肢，然后被人抬回了陆家。
直至今夜，陆宸不甘的咽了气，任逍遥也因此重生到了陆宸身上，变成了这个倒霉蛋。
作为曾经的武道巅峰强者，任逍遥一眼就看穿了发生在陆宸身上的所有把戏，也有些同情陆宸。

不过，一想到自己重生成了一个丹田和经脉尽毁的废物，任逍遥欲哭无泪，又同情起自己来。
现在两人合二为一，陆宸倒霉，那就是他倒霉，有了这样一副身体，他就是有力也无处使啊。
突然，不知如何是好的任逍遥发现自己的手里握着一个东西，转头一看，居然是一个珠子。
这个珠子通体漆黑，像是石头打磨而成的，只有鸽子蛋那么大，是陆宸以前随手捡来的玩意。
看着手里的石珠，任逍遥突然来了兴趣，他试图拿起来看一下，结果发现自己被包成了一个粽子，动都动不了。
任逍遥倔强的要坐起来，结果却因此牵动了内伤，哇的一声，一口鲜血径直喷了出来。
任逍遥一部分鲜血喷到了石珠上，石珠诡异的将鲜血吞噬了，紧接着，石珠散发出黄色光芒。
任逍遥瞪大双眼，震惊的看着眼前的石珠，因为他见过不少宝贝，意识到眼前的石珠极为不凡。
之后，石珠中散发出一股恐怖吸力，在一阵惨痛中，任逍遥一闪而逝，从冷清的房间消失了。

> Chapter 1 The Rebirth of the Sword Emperor (Page 1)
Late at night, in a deserted room, a young man with his whole body covered in bandages suddenly woke up and looked at the unfamiliar surroundings with a confused look on his face.
His name is Ren Xiaoyao, and he is the second-ranked Sword Emperor among the top ten titled Martial Emperors in the Shenwu world. He is a master of swords and elixirs. He has become the number one swordsman in the Shenwu world at the age of sixty.
The moment before, he was defeated by thousands of evil demons and exploded in the Demon Mountains.
But in the blink of an eye, he actually appeared in this strange place, and strangely transformed into a seriously injured young man.
Just when Ren Xiaoyao was wondering whether he had snatched the young man's body, he felt a sharp pain in his head, and then a large amount of memories flooded into Ren Xiaoyao's mind.
These memories came from the owner of this body. When the pain disappeared, Ren Xiaoyao digested the memories in his mind and understood everything around him.
He did not seize the body, but was reborn into a young man named Lu Chen, and he was reborn a hundred years later.
As for Lu Chen, he is a member of the Lu family, one of the four major families in Tianyuan City. He is sixteen years old and a poor little guy.
Six years ago, Lu Chen's father, Lu Yi, was attacked by a mysterious man in the Luofeng Mountains. His dantian and meridians were all destroyed, and he became a cripple.
After that, Lu Yi, who single-handedly led the entire Lu family from a lowly family to become the strongest family in Tianyuan City, with overall strength second only to the City Lord's Mansion, was deprived of his position as the head of the family, and his eldest brother Lu Qian succeeded him as the head of the family.
At the age of twelve, Lu Chen detected high-grade earth veins with dual attributes of gold and earth, and became the most talented person in Tianyuan City in the past three hundred years. Even the city lord's palace could not compare.
In the next four short years, Lu Chen's martial arts progressed rapidly, and he reached the seventh-level martial arts realm. He was spotted by Li Wu, the ninth elder of Jiange who went out to practice, and allowed him to enter Jiange to practice.
Suddenly, Lu Chen became the most dazzling young man in Tianyuan City.
However, just when everyone thought Lu Chen had a bright future, tragedy happened again. Lu Chen's meridians and Dantian were destroyed, turning him into a useless person like Lu Yi.
Unlike Lu Yi, the deposed Lu Chen received an invitation during the day and went to Tianxiang Pavilion. Soon after, it was revealed that he had molested Lin Xuan, the proud daughter of the Lin family.
Lu Chen, who had his meridians and Dantian destroyed, had his limbs broken and was carried back to the Lu family.
Until tonight, Lu Chen died unwillingly, and Ren Xiaoyao was reborn into Lu Chen and became this unlucky guy.
As a former martial arts master, Ren Xiaoyao could see through all the tricks that happened to Lu Chen at a glance, and he also sympathized with Lu Chen.
However, when he thought that he was reborn as a waste with his dantian and meridians destroyed, Ren Xiaoyao felt like crying but felt sorry for himself.
Now that the two of them merged into one, Lu Chen was unlucky, and that was him. With such a body, even if he was powerful, he could not use it.
Suddenly, Ren Xiaoyao, who didn't know what to do, found something in his hand. He turned around and saw that it was a bead.
This bead was completely black and looked like it was made of polished stone. It was only as big as a pigeon egg. It was something Lu Chen had picked up casually before.
Looking at the stone bead in his hand, Ren Xiaoyao suddenly became interested. He tried to pick it up and look at it, but found that he was wrapped into a rice dumpling and could not move.
Ren Xiaoyao stubbornly tried to sit up, but as a result, he suffered internal injuries. With a whoosh, a mouthful of blood spurted out.
Ren Xiaoyao sprayed some of his blood onto the stone bead, and the stone bead swallowed the blood strangely. Then, the stone bead emitted a yellow light.
Ren Xiaoyao's eyes widened and he looked at the stone beads in front of him in shock, because he had seen many treasures and realized that the stone beads in front of him were extremely extraordinary.
After that, a terrifying suction force emitted from the stone bead. In a burst of misery, Ren Xiaoyao passed away in a flash and returned to the deserted world.The room disappeared.
